description: S52 T4 (LM1, LM5, LM6): the AGENT's own read of memory — learnings.mine.query answers the readable set and nothing else: the person's word, learnings filed under the projects this agent's steps have actually run in, and the agent's own memory. Daemon-side filters only (queryText, tags, limit) — a person-scope widening or an actor param does not exist on this door, and a person session reaching it is refused by name (the opposite of the human-door pattern: here the AGENT view is the scoped one). Why each hit reads where it does is answered beside it: the M1 ordering note plus the basis sentence (D5/D6 — similarity within the set, never a re-widening).
